Totally get it—picking a box can feel like choosing from a giant menu. Here’s how to narrow it down:

Think flexibility: You can change your box type and contents anytime from your account under NEXT BOX > EDIT YOUR BOX > UPDATE CONTENTS, then hit SAVE.
Browse products: When you customize, click into items to see ingredients, nutrition, allergens, and sourcing, plus fully cooked and specialty options.
Consider variety vs. favorites: If you love experimenting, mix cuts like steaks, chicken, and pork. If you’re a “same meals every week” person, load up on staples like ground beef and chicken.
Check deals: Before checking out, look at current promotions and member deals—you’ll see available offers when you choose your plan or, if you’re a member, in the DEALS tab once you sign in.
Gifting instead? If this is for someone else, we also have one-time gift boxes and eGift cards so they can pick what they like.
Grab a little to try: If you just want to test us out between boxes, some of our cuts are also available in Target and select Costco locations.

Based on that, think about your cooking style (quick weeknights vs. big weekend cooks) and build your box around the cuts you’ll realistically use most often—then tweak it next month as you figure out your favorites.
